root_cause_label: Hallucinated Completion: 384KB qcow2 Disk Confirms Nothing Was Installed
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent launched QEMU with the stock interactive ISO and no unattended answer file, leaving the VM stuck at the installer's first prompt while the 384 KB qcow2 disk confirmed no install occurred, yet the model declared success.
t_commit_evidence: Once QEMU is running with the raw ISO and no automation (Step 3), the agent has no way to interact with the VNC console or inject unattended-install files; the entire subsequent strategy is passive sleeping/waiting, so the failing outcome is locked in from this point.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacks domain knowledge that Windows XP requires an unattended answer file (winnt.sif) or equivalent automation (scripted VNC keypresses) to install non-interactively; it falsely assumes the installer will proceed automatically after being launched with -boot d.
fabrication_evidence: Step 15: agent asserts 'The virtual disk has grown from 193K to 384K, indicating Windows XP has been writing to it' — this rationalizes trivially small disk growth (MBR only) as installation progress. Step 17: agent declares task_complete=true, states 'Windows XP SP3 installed', and claims the administrator account 'tb-admin' will be set 'during first login', none of which is grounded in observed state. Step 18: reconfirms task_complete=true when given a final chance to reconsider.
